Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_Enabled_tooltip: Turns every Knox Survivors system on or off. Default on. Existing survivor records and settings are preserved while it is off.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SpawnWithSpouse_to: A new character starts with one generated spouse companion nearby whose identity and personality stay fixed in that save. Default off; set it before starting a character. If your next character inherits the household, the existing spouse stays with it and no second spouse is created.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ContinueSurvivorsA: After your character dies, your base and living companions pass to your next character and become residents. Default on; off leaves the old ownership unchanged. The existing spouse stays with that household, so no second spouse is created.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowCompanionHUD_t: Shows the companion status panel on the right while you have companions. Default on. It lists each companion's condition and current order; hiding it changes no behavior.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowActivityFeed_t: Shows the small Knox Survivors feed of survivor activity, orders and spoken lines. Default on; speech has its own setting, and the feed only lists events. Hiding it does not stop anything from happening.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorSpeech: Shows speech bubbles above survivors and lets spoken lines appear in the activity feed. Default on. Turning it off leaves the feed running for orders and status, but no speech is voiced or written.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowSurvivorNamepl: Shows player-style names above survivors you can see. Default on. Names still need line of sight and stay inside the name distance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorNameplateD: Maximum distance in tiles for visible survivor names, 8 to 40. Default 24. Line of sight is still required; this only changes the range.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_OrderGestures_tool: Player orders use native Follow, Stop and Move Out gestures, and nearby free survivors can nod in acknowledgement. Default on. Gestures are rate limited and suppressed in combat, traversal and queued actions.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowRadialOrders: Show Knox Orders in Emote Radial
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowRadialOrders_t: Adds Knox companion, resident and nearby-survivor orders to the vanilla emote radial. Default on. Turning it off leaves vanilla radial actions intact.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowLegacyContextC: Show Knox Orders in Right-Click Menus

Adds the older Knox order menus to right-click. Default off because the emote radial already covers them. Sending a scout and ordering window barricades from your own base stay in the base menu either way.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_WorldPopulation_to: How many persistent survivor identities the save aims to keep alive across the county. Default 420, range 0 to 8,192: enough for families, loners and a few factions without turning the county into a crowd. People appear over time, only nearby bodies load, and existing people are never deleted.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PopulationRefillDa: In-game days between replacement survivors, or new arrivals when caps are disabled. Default 7, range 0 to 30; zero means a finite starting population with no routine replacements. Re-enabling starts a full interval, and missed arrivals never accumulate.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupChance: Percent chance that starting survivors form a small travelling group when the world is first populated. Default 45, range 0 to 100: most people are alone. Formation still needs nearby origins and is limited by the maximum starting groups.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupMaxSiz: Largest group formed from starting survivors, 2 to 6. Default 4. This does not change total county population; it only decides how those people cluster.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialGroupCount_: Maximum compact survivor groups formed when the world is first populated, 0 to 512. Default 48; zero disables opening groups and founding factions. Needs nearby origins and a group chance, and total population is unchanged.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_InitialFactionCoun: Maximum opening groups that begin as persistent factions, 0 to 64. Default 6, at most one per spawn region; zero disables founding factions. Needs NPC Factions and enough real members, and creates no supplies or finished work.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DisableSurvivorCap: Ignores the loaded-survivor and companion limits. Default off; world population still sets the starting count, and one newcomer may arrive per refill interval even above it. Large populations cost performance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MaxActiveSurvivors: Maximum nearby survivor bodies loaded at once, 1 to 128. Default 24; off-screen people keep their identity, needs and travel progress. Higher limits cost more performance, and loading stays spread across updates.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ActivationsPerUpda: Maximum new survivor bodies loaded in one population update, 1 to 4. Default 2. Higher values let nearby groups appear together but can cause a short performance spike.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MinimumSpawnDistan: Closest distance in tiles from a player when a survivor first appears, 25 to 150. Default 40. Survivors must also be out of sight, so this never causes visible pop-in.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorEncounterD: How close a persistent survivor must be before their body can load, 120 to 500 tiles. Default 220; larger values use loaded slots faster. The effective distance stays at least 10 tiles beyond the minimum spawn distance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CompanionLimit_too: Maximum companions each local player can recruit, 1 to 12. Default 4. Base residents are not followers and do not count against it; the loaded-survivor cap still applies.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerFormation_: Preferred positions behind a leader: Paired puts two followers in each row, while Single File forms a narrower, longer column. Default Paired; obstacles and pathfinding can break the shape. This does not control vehicles or combat positioning.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FollowerSpacing_to: Tiles between preferred follower positions on each axis, 1 to 3. Default 1 keeps the close formation. Larger values spread the group and put rear members farther back; blocked positions still use nearby-tile recovery.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorDoorW: Allow Survivors to Open Doors and Windows

Default permission for survivors to open closed doors and windows while pathing. Default on; individual orders override it. Survivors without permission still pass through open or smashed openings and report the block.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorsTrea: Nearby owned companions and base residents with a bandage can treat your bleeding when idle and safe. Default on. Active jobs and combat stay higher priority, and this creates no bandages.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_CautiousTravel_too: Survivors crouch while walking ordinary supply, work and travel routes between places, and straighten up once a zombie has spotted them or is within reach. Default on. Escape and catching up can still run; off restores distance-based jogging.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowAutonomousRet: Autonomous survivors may use the bounded retreat decision when danger and a safe lane justify it. Experimental and off by default while the member-level retreat is rebuilt; a leader's group withdrawal order still works. Off does not disable combat, threat detection, the raid alarm fallback or orders.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ZombieEngagementDi: Farthest distance for automatically engaging an idle visible zombie, 2 to 16 tiles. Default 4, and lower values favor avoidance; attacks on themselves or allies still trigger defense within 8 tiles and a fight can continue within 6. Companion orders keep their own range.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_SurvivorAimingAssi: How well survivors shoot. Cannot hit anything to Insanely accurate; the middle setting is Balanced. Aiming assistance only changes how quickly a survivor commits and settles their aim, never their perk or XP.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EFZFirearmCompatib: Use Escape From Zomboid Firearms Guns

When Escape From Zomboid Firearms is installed, survivors consider its magazines and ammunition and may pick a viable gun even with low Aiming. Default off; native actions still load and fire. Vanilla and other weapon mods work without it.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutoGenerateBaseWo: Lets autonomous NPC factions create guard, patrol, farming, wood, corpse and storage areas at their own bases. Default on. Player base areas stay manual.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseCooking_toolti: Residents make compatible meals from assigned cookware and two different ingredients, heat the result in an empty stove or powered microwave, then return it to storage. Default on. They may also cook unsafe raw food directly; optional cooking areas limit appliance choice.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_BaseReading_toolti: Idle residents read suitable carried books or borrow assigned supplies. Default on. Normal reading, lighting, literacy and skill rules apply; borrowed books are returned, and danger or new orders interrupt.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental: Qualified residents repair stationary engines inside their base through Repair work. Default off; needs a real wrench, EngineParts and an unlocked or missing hood, and opening the hood may trip the alarm. Native repair runs and parts are consumed, with acceptance pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ToolCupboardCapaci: Only affects old saves that still contain a legacy Tool Cupboard policy, 100 to 2,000. Default 500. Current typed storage uses each container's native capacity, and changing this never deletes contents.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableExperimental: Enables experimental Drive Ahead and map driving orders while you are a passenger. Default off; needs a running vehicle and a free driver seat or a companion already driving. Routes use loaded outdoor ground up to 160 tiles, towing is unsupported, and native acceptance is pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NpcDrivingSpeed_to: Speed limit for NPC drivers in km/h, 5 to 30, used only while NPC Driving is on. Default 20; they slow further for turns and stopping distance.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowNPCFactions_t: Lets survivor groups form factions and establish bases. Default on. Existing factions are not removed when it is turned off.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMinimumM: Survivors Needed to Form a Faction
Survivors a travelling group needs before it can become a faction, 3 to 8. Default 4. Members must still build familiarity through shared survival.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_NPCFactionMaxMembe: Normal maximum faction size, 3 to 24. Default 8. The effective limit is never below the minimum to form a faction, and lowering it never removes existing members.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowHostileEncoun: Independent survivors can threaten or rob one another when they meet. Default on. Violence also needs Allow Survivor and Player Combat; factions and reputation still shape who turns hostile.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowSurvivorPlaye: Hostile survivors and players can fight one another. Default on. Relationship and hostility rules still decide who attacks; off leaves threats and robbery in place without violence.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_UseReputation_tool: Survivors judge you by trust earned through talk, gifts, help and fights, and low reputation blocks recruiting. Default on. Off recruits on contact rules alone.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableKnoxEvents_t: Dispatches scripted faction and named-world events. Default on, with automatic arrivals and raids on their own switches. Native objectives, return and save acceptance are pending; existing event records are preserved.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AutomaticFactionEn: Lets named factions arrive automatically when Knox Events is on. Default on; off allows only manual developer entries. County population and active events are unaffected, and native arrival, objective and return acceptance is pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionEntryMinimu: Earliest world day for an automatic faction arrival, 1 to 90. Default 7; needs Knox Events and Automatic Faction Arrivals. Ordinary county people are unaffected.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionEntryInterv: Minimum in-game days between automatic arrival checks, 1 to 30. Default 10. Only one automatic arrival can be active at a time, and an eligible destination is still required.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PoliceNeighborhood: Police bases with at least three residents can generate a separate outdoor neighborhood route. Default on; needs automatic NPC base work areas and four loaded standing stops. Existing routes keep their bounds, and native acceptance is pending.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_PolicePatrolMargin: Farthest distance beyond facility bounds when generating a new police route, 4 to 32 tiles. Default 16. Routes stay capped at 64 tiles per side and grant no ownership; existing routes keep their bounds.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MilitaryFacilityCl: Military residents on claimed security duties engage visible idle zombies inside their facility. Default on; duty bounds, sight, barriers, needs and retreat still apply, with no off-screen kills or cleared marker. Off stops new clearance but not self-defense.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_MilitaryClearanceD: Distance for military security residents to consider idle zombies inside their own facility, 2 to 16 tiles. Default 8. Facility bounds, walls and floors still block engagement.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowFactionRaids_: Hostile factions with a real base, members and a recorded grievance may send a raid against an existing base. Default on until native raid, return and save acceptance. Needs Knox Events, NPC Factions and hostile encounters; off stops new raids without cancelling one underway.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidMinimum: Earliest world day an established hostile faction can plan a raid, 1 to 90. Default 21. Needs Faction Raids, Knox Events and hostile encounters.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_FactionRaidInterva: Minimum in-game days between automatic raid checks, 1 to 30. Default 10. Only one automatic raid can be active at a time.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_EnableDeveloperToo: Adds testing commands to the world context menu. Default off and not intended for normal play. Commands can spawn survivors and alter the test area.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperScenario_: Optionally creates a repeatable test population when the save loads: None, Single Survivor, Companion, Travel Group, Faction or Faction Seeking a Base. Default None. Manual spawn commands stay available from the world context menu.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_DeveloperSpawnDist: Minimum distance in tiles used when placing test survivors around the player, 6 to 30. Default 10.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_AllowDestructiveDe: Developer tests may smash windows or alter the test area when this is on. Default off; keep it off on saves you care about. The other test commands still work.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_ShowDeveloperDiagn: Writes detailed test state to the console and Knox logs. Default off because it is only useful during focused testing.
Sandbox_KnoxSurvivors_IgnoreJobResourceR: Ignore Job Tool and Resource Requirements

Gives survivors the real tools and materials for supported base jobs, including barricading, without stocking storage first. Default off. Native actions still animate and consume the items; skills, targets and world rules still apply.
